basic_details.job_title: IIM Ranchi Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: A two-year contract post at consolidated pay equal to Pay Level 10 is open at the Indian Institute of Management Ranchi. The Manager (Academics) post (1 vacancy, UR) needs a Post Graduation or equivalent with 55% marks and at least 8 years of relevant supervisory experience in an academic institution. Online applications run from 9 November 2026 to 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026 through the Institute website, iimranchi.ac.in.

age_limit.details: Not exceeding the age of 50 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen candidates is as per Government of India rules.

how_to_apply: Apply online through the Institute website https://www.iimranchi.ac.in/ as per the prescribed procedure, along with relevant documents. The eligibility details and online link are on the careers page, https://iimranchi.ac.in/careers/.
Submit the application between 9 November 2026 and 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026.
Enter a correct and active e-mail address in the online form, because the Institute corresponds by e-mail only.
After successful online submission, obtain a print out of the application form.
Submit the print out when called for interview; it is required at document verification/interview.
Do not send a hard copy of the application to the Institute.
For technical issues, write to [email protected]. For any other issue, write to [email protected].
Print out of the online application form (for interview/document verification).
Educational, category, experience and salary certificates or documents, needed at the time of application; no additional time is given to produce them.
Relevant category certificate in the GOI format for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD/Ex-Servicemen candidates, at the time of interview.
Salary certificates or pay slips and proof of salary credit in the account for the entire period of claimed work experience.

Experience certificate on the organisation's letter head with date of issue, specific period of work (DD/MM/YYYY), nature of duties, name, designation, pay particulars, and the signature and seal of the Administrative Authority/Owner.
No Objection Certificate for those working in Government/Public Sector Establishments/Autonomous Institutions, if called for interview.
Latest photograph; forms without the required certificates or the latest photograph are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian Nationals may apply. The single vacancy is unreserved (UR). Minimum 8 years of relevant supervisory experience in an academic institution, preferably in a Business School or CFTI. Applicants should have experience in academic administration and government-related matters and a flair for serving an academic institution. Only relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree is considered. Internships or Traineeships are not counted as work experience. The experience requirement is relaxable at the discretion of the Institute. Not exceeding the age of 50 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen candidates is as per Government of India rules. Candidates should have sound health and good moral character. They should not be involved in or related to any criminal case or any offence or act involving moral turpitude. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.minimum_qualification: Post Graduation or equivalent from a recognized university/institute with 55% marks or its equivalent

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A consolidated salary equivalent to Pay Level 10 (Gross) is paid every month during the contract term. The appointee is entitled to Group Medical Insurance as per the Institute's policy. If a retired senior official from the Central/State Government, CFTIs, Public Sector Undertakings or Defence Forces is selected, the consolidated salary is fixed as per Govt. of India guidelines. The initial contract period is 2 (two) years. The contract may be extended for a further period of up to 2 (two) years on a 1+1 year basis, subject to performance review and the requirement of the Institute. A contractual appointment does not create any right to a claim for future appointment in any contractual or regular position.

content_sections.heading: IIM Ranchi Manager (Academics) Job Description
content_sections.text: Handling activities of Academic Programmes and other academic and non-academic assignments. Supervising overall management and handling of activities related to admissions and academic administration of the Academic Programmes. Liaison with Visiting/Guest faculty with respect to programme and sessions. Preparation of the Academic calendar and Area teaching plans under the guidance of respective Programme Chairpersons. Interaction with candidates/participants of different programmes. Scheduling of classes, conduct of exams and preparation of grade sheets. Maintaining fellowship/contingency funds and liaising for accommodation and mess facilities for participants attending Programmes.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Ranchi Manager (Academics)
content_sections.text: Apply online through the Institute website https://www.iimranchi.ac.in/ as per the prescribed procedure, along with relevant documents. The eligibility details and online link are on the careers page, https://iimranchi.ac.in/careers/ . Submit the application between 9 November 2026 and 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026. Enter a correct and active e-mail address in the online form, because the Institute corresponds by e-mail only. After successful online submission, obtain a print out of the application form. Submit the print out when called for interview; it is required at document verification/interview. Do not send a hard copy of the application to the Institute. For technical issues, write to [email protected] . For any other issue, write to [email protected] . Print out of the online application form (for interview/document verification). Educational, category, experience and salary certificates or documents, needed at the time of application; no additional time is given to produce them. Relevant category certificate in the GOI format for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD/Ex-Servicemen candidates, at the time of interview. Salary certificates or pay slips and proof of salary credit in the account for the entire period of claimed work experience. Experience certificate on the organisation's letter head with date of issue, specific period of work (DD/MM/YYYY), nature of duties, name, designation, pay particulars, and the signature and seal of the Administrative Authority/Owner. No Objection Certificate for those working in Government/Public Sector Establishments/Autonomous Institutions, if called for interview. Latest photograph; forms without the required certificates or the latest photograph are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received are scrutinised and only shortlisted candidates are called for interview. Meeting the advertised requirements does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called. Selection is made on the basis of the candidate's previous records and performance in the interview. The Institute may set higher criteria for shortlisting and decide the criteria or procedure for it. The selection committee may decide its own method of evaluating interview performance. The Institute may hold a written test and/or interview for selection, as required. The interview schedule and the copies of certificates to be submitted are e-mailed to the registered e-mail address; no separate letter is sent by post. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Ranchi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Manager (Academics), in the UR category. The notice says the number of posts is tentative.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIM Ranchi Manager (Academics)?
faq.answer: The last date for online applications is 30 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Applications opened on 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIM Ranchi Manager (Academics)?
faq.answer: Post Graduation or equivalent from a recognized university/institute with 55% marks or its equivalent, plus minimum 8 years of relevant supervisory experience in an academic institution, preferably in a Business School or CFTI.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIM Ranchi Manager (Academics)?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 50 years as on the last date of application. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen is as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IIM Ranchi Manager (Academics)?
faq.answer: Consolidated Pay equivalent to Pay Level 10 (Gross), paid every month during the contract. Group Medical Insurance is given as per the Institute's policy.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIM Ranchi Manager (Academics)?
faq.answer: Apply online through the Institute website, iimranchi.ac.in, using the link on its careers page. Do not send a hard copy; take the print out of the application to the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How is the Manager (Academics) selected at IIM Ranchi?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and shortlisted candidates are called for interview. Selection is based on previous records and interview performance, and the Institute may also hold a written test.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIM Ranchi Manager (Academics) post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual post. The initial contract is 2 years and may be extended for up to 2 further years on a 1+1 year basis, subject to performance review and the Institute's requirement.

faq.question: Q9. Will IIM Ranchi pay TA/DA for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is paid to applicants for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the experience requirement be relaxed?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says the experience requirement is relaxable at the discretion of the Institute. Internships or Traineeships are not counted as work experience.
